privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data we process when you use Gamebook Secret Passage and how to exercise your rights.

sections.p:
· Account data: email address and hashed password.
· Content: stories, passages, images and project metadata.
· Technical data: IP address, browser and error logs.
· Payments: we do not store card details; our payment provider handles them.
We use your data to provide the Service, authenticate you, sync your content, manage subscriptions, prevent abuse and answer support requests.
We process data based on performance of the contract (the Service), your consent (optional content) and our legitimate interest (security and product improvement).
We use hosting, authentication, payment and, optionally, artificial intelligence providers. They only access the data needed to deliver their service and act under their own policies.
We keep data while your account is active and as long as needed to meet legal obligations. You can request account deletion and we will erase your data unless the law requires us to keep it.
You can request access, rectification, portability or deletion of your data. Write to us by opening an issue in the GitHub repository with the email linked to your account.
We apply reasonable measures: encryption in transit, hashed passwords and limited access to information. No system is infallible, but we work to protect your data.
The Service is not directed at minors who cannot consent on their own. If we detect a minor's data without authorization, we will delete it.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Got a problem, an idea or a question? Here is how to reach us.
support.githubHint: When opening an issue, include the steps to reproduce the bug, your browser and screenshots if possible. Never include passwords or payment details.

sections.p: Report bugs through the GitHub repository (issues). The more details you provide, the faster we can fix them.
Use "question" or "enhancement" issues for usage questions or improvement ideas. We review community feedback regularly.
We are a small team and usually reply within a few business days. We prioritize issues that block basic use of the Service.
If the site fails to load or a feature does not respond, first check the open issues in the repository; we post notices about outages or maintenance there.
For legal, privacy or billing matters, open an issue with the appropriate label. We do not publish a public email: all communication happens on GitHub.
